one atomic caller graph, original WS callbacks and manager models, 14 integrated checks including SIGKILL/fresh-process recovery and repeated checkpoints; 12 isolated DTA serialization cases and 3 SIGKILL/fresh-process procedure recoveries with native data, aliases, constraints and subclass state; actual ON_LINE and ON_STEP checkpoints, fresh-process recovery, nested return operands, native data and ARGS/IVARS/PROC aliases; safe Python cleanup, missing files and corrupt/source-mismatched checkpoint rejection without deleting input checkpoints; monotonic status deadlines, virtual login completion/timeout/cancellation and context close with one owned pending service; two owned context SIGKILL cases preserve the same native child, pause progress, reattach through original IPC and close normally;
